lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Paul Reyes is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Paul is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Paul Reyes is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Paul kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Paul's gone." Mateo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Paul." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Brianna blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Brawler's Instinct (Level 1). You read a fight as it moves. The body tells you what the mouth won't.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Intimidating Presence (Level 1). You don't have to fight. Most people decide not to, just looking at you.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Paul Reyes, 41 days. The mantle passes to Brianna Robertson.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Brianna Robertson, 52 — a dockworker. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Lucky Rock.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Paul — and Paul is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Carlos, Helen, Jalen and 3 more speak for Brianna — "Paul trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Brianna before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
